mapper.select: select id, member_id, status, apply_time, execute_after, cancel_time, complete_time, failure_reason, create_time, update_time from account_deregistration where member_id = #{memberId} order by apply_time desc, id desc limit 1
select id, member_id, status, apply_time, execute_after, cancel_time, complete_time, failure_reason, create_time, update_time from account_deregistration where id = #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into account_deregistration (member_id, status, apply_time, execute_after, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{status}, #{applyTime}, #{executeAfter}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update ums_member set deregister_status = 'NORMAL', deregister_apply_time = null, deregister_execute_after = null, update_time = now() where id = #{memberId} and del_flag = 0
mapper.select: select id, member_id, status, apply_time, execute_after, cancel_time, complete_time, failure_reason, create_time, update_time from account_deregistration where status = 'PENDING' and execute_after <= #{now} order by execute_after asc, id asc limit 100
select count(1) from refund_application where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = 0 and (status = 0 or (status = 1 and (payout_status is null or payout_status not in (1, 4))))
mapper.update: update ums_member set phone = null, password = null, name = null, wechat = null, nickname = '已注销用户', avatar = null, wx_open_id = null, union_id = null, apple_id = null, mark = null, case_pics = null, case_introducton = null, website = null, work_address = null, introduction = null, deregister_status = 'COMPLETED', del_flag = 2, update_time = now() where id = #{memberId}

update oms_order set receiver_name = '已注销用户', receiver_phone = null, receiver_phone_hash = null, receiver_phone_code = null, receiver_province = null, receiver_detail_address = null, update_time = now() where member_id = #{memberId}

update ums_member_withdrawal set realname = null, bank_name = null, bank_account = null, mobilephone = null, realname_enc = null, bank_name_enc = null, bank_account_enc = null, mobilephone_enc = null, realname_mask = null, bank_name_mask = null, bank_account_mask = null, mobilephone_mask = null where member_id = #{memberId}
update member_cash_withdraw set openid = null where member_id = #{memberId}
